values.note: DNR: 'Reservations are required.' Booked on Maryland's reservation site or at 1-888-432-2267, up to 365 days ahead and for the same day ('Reservations can be made for today'). Check-in 3 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/WolfDenRun/Camping.aspx ('Reservations are required.'; 'The maximum camping reservation is 14 days.'; 'Check-in time is 3:00 p.m. Check-out time is 12:00 p.m.') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/wolf-den-run-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380136 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/WolfDenRun/Camping.aspx ('10 primitive campsites with a fire ring and picnic table ... The area is undeveloped with no running water or bathhouse.') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/wolf-den-run-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380136 (all 10 campsites 'Campsite Non-Electric'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 10 primitive sites, 6 of them for RVs or trailers and 4 tent sites, plus 2 glamping tents. DNR caps a camping unit at 25 ft (the booking site lists 30 ft for the six RV sites). Sites 'are currently not stabilized'; DNR plans stabilized pads, more sites and a bathhouse.

sites.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/WolfDenRun/Camping.aspx ('Currently 10 primitive campsites ... The sites are currently not stabilized. Plans to expand the camping area, create stabilized pads, and construct a bathhouse are underway.'; 'Maximum length of camping unit is 25''.') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/wolf-den-run-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380136 (site details: 6 'RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site' with Max Vehicle Length 30, 4 'Tent Site'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: A porta pot; no running water or bathhouse.

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/WolfDenRun/Camping.aspx ('The area is undeveloped with no running water or bathhouse. A porta pot is available.'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Read DNR's Wolf Den Run camping page and the booking site: reservation required (booking.fcfs never, replacing the inherited walk-in default), 365-day window with same-day booking, 14-night maximum; 10 unstabilized primitive sites (6 RV) with a 25-ft unit limit, no hookups, no water or showers, porta pot. Fees (human-checked, $10-11) and year-round season match. Not stated: weekend/holiday minimums (left inherited).
flags: Criteria (4WD, conditional): DNR's camping page says 'During winter months, campsites and driveways are not plowed and may be covered in snow and ice. A four-wheel drive vehicle may be necessary to access the campsite.' (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/WolfDenRun/Camping.aspx). AWH 2026-10-21: a conditional 'may be required' counts as a flag.

Criteria (OHV park): Wolf Den Run is an ORV state park and the campground serves its riders: 'ORV's ... may only be used to travel to or from Wolf Den Run approved trail riding areas through the main entrance and exit ... Huckleberry Rocks area is the only area that can be traveled to by ORV from the campground'; ORV quiet-hours rules (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/WolfDenRun/Camping.aspx). The campground bans riding inside it ('Zero Tolerance for OHV riding in the campground'). AWH 2026-10-02: OHV staging camps are out, general campgrounds with an OHV side stay; a human should decide which this is.
Site length: DNR's rule caps a camping unit at 25 ft, the booking site lists 30 ft; EKKO fits either way.
Phone: entry has none; DNR gives the Wolf Den Run office 301-334-1272 (on-site duty ranger 301-616-3619) (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/wolf-den-run.aspx).
Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's camping page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/WolfDenRun/Camping.aspx.
